title: Madrid Residency Night 5 — "Coco Chanel" Exclusive; Pope Leo XIV Jokes About Bad Bunny Competition
detail: Bad Bunny performs Night 5 of his 10-night Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid before 64,000 fans — the opening show of Cluster 3 (June 6–7). The exclusive song for Night 5 is 'Coco Chanel,' his collaboration with Eladio Carrión. Five of the ten sold-out nights are now complete, with total attendance exceeding 320,000 fans across the residency's first cluster (May 30–31), second cluster (June 2–3), and the start of the third cluster. The same weekend, Pope Leo XIV — making his first apostolic journey to Spain — publicly acknowledged the competition for Madrid audiences. Speaking to pilgrims, the Pope quipped: 'If they are confronted with the question: Do you want to go see Bad Bunny or the Pope? I think many will see Bad Bunny. But I think there will also be a few here to see the Pope.' The remark — covered by AP, NBC, ABC News, and The Hill — generated massive international press for Bad Bunny on June 6–7, with approximately 500,000 people gathering at Plaza de Lima for the papal vigil the same night Bad Bunny performed at the stadium. The Latin Times described Madrid as 'a global gathering point' for the weekend, with both events drawing hundreds of thousands simultaneously.
